dialogues.speaker: Xuanfan
dialogues.text: That's right! It happened just as I was starting to think that I should leave the fleet due to my dismay at our lack of results...

dialogues.speaker: Xuanfan
dialogues.text: It was at that moment that the "Alcor" passed us by, and I saw Captain Beidou standing at the helm...

dialogues.speaker: Xuanfan
dialogues.text: ...And in that moment, our eyes met.

dialogues.speaker: Xuanfan
dialogues.text: I just happened to be on her left, and that courage of hers that subdued the seas themselves pierced my heart in one glance.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Isn't that the side with the eyepatch?

dialogues.speaker: Xuanfan
dialogues.text: Yes, of course, but ah, details!

dialogues.speaker: Xuanfan
dialogues.text: She truly is great! With but a single look, she was able to save the spent soul of a sorrowful sailor...
